title: BI & Analytics Platform
seo_title: BI & Analytics Platform | Achala IT Solutions
meta_description: BI & Analytics Platform delivers operational dashboards, KPI monitoring and decision support on your own data.

blocks.x: Decisions with numbers behind them. BI & Analytics Platform turns your operational data into dashboards and KPI monitoring that leaders actually use.

BI & Analytics Platform is the reporting layer for an operation: pipelines bring the data together, dashboards present it by role, and KPI monitoring flags the metrics that drift. The platform runs on your estate, your data never leaves your controls.

items: Role-based views for executives, managers and teams
Thresholds and alerts on the metrics that matter
Sources unified with documented, owned transformations
Trends and comparisons prepared for the weekly review

blocks.x: The platform runs on cloud or on-premise infrastructure alongside your warehouse estate. Pipelines are versioned and owned; dashboards and alerts follow role-based access; every metric has a documented definition.

items: One definition per KPI, shared by every report
Data visibility follows your access policy
Runs inside your perimeter where required

blocks.x: Hospital groups, logistics operators, manufacturing plants and financial-service teams, any operation whose weekly review needs numbers everyone trusts.
Book a briefing with the BI team. Bring one messy report and we will show the dashboard and pipeline it would become.
